subtitle: Megas in the Mountains: How Eucratides Split the Greek East

panels.shot: low-angle dramatic wide of a stormy mountain pass with armies on both sides of the Hindu Kush
panels.action: Eucratides Megas stands in ornate Hellenistic armor on a rocky Afghan ridge, wind whipping his cloak, one hand on a vast gold coin, while distant Greek-style banners face each other across snow-capped mountains.

dialogue.text: In the high winds of Bactria, Eucratides Megas rose against his own kings—and broke the Indo-Greek world in two.

i18n.hi: बैक्ट्रिया की तेज़ आँधियों में युक्राटीडीज़ मेगास ने अपने ही राजाओं के ख़िलाफ़ उठकर भारत-यूनानी दुनिया को दो टुकड़ों में तोड़ दिया।

panels.shot: wide aerial over the Oxus valley
panels.action: A bird’s-eye view of the lush Oxus valley shows walled cities, irrigation canals, and caravan lines stretching towards distant snow peaks under a clear Central Asian sky.

dialogue.text: A century after Alexander, Bactria was a rich hinge of the world—Greek cities on Iranian soil, guarding the passes to India.

i18n.hi: अलेक्ज़ान्डर के सौ साल बाद, बैक्ट्रिया दुनिया की धनी कड़ी था—ईरानी ज़मीन पर यूनानी शहर, जो भारत के दर्रों की रखवाली कर रहे थे।

panels.shot: slow push-in on a stylized timeline frieze of kings and coins
panels.action: Carved in stone like a frieze, a sequence of Hellenistic rulers and their coins flows from Seleucid kings to Euthydemus and Demetrius, ending in a break where the stone is cracked and darkened.

dialogue.text: Seleucid governors became Bactrian kings. Euthydemus held the Oxus; Demetrius carried Greek banners over the Hindu Kush into India.

i18n.hi: सेल्यूसिड सूबेदार बैक्ट्रियन राजा बने। युथीडेमस ने ऑक्सस थामा, डेमेट्रियस यूनानी झंडे उठाकर हिंदूकुश पार भारत तक पहुँच गया।

panels.shot: intimate mid-shot inside a palace hall
panels.action: In a dim Bactrian palace hall decorated with Greek columns and local motifs, Eucratides stands as a middle-aged noble in fine but not yet royal dress, listening grimly while courtiers whisper and gesture towards a distant map.

dialogue.text: In this world of frontier kings, Eucratides first appears not as conqueror, but as a name on coins—Eucratides, later styled Megas, the Great.

i18n.hi: सीमा-राजाओं की इस दुनिया में युक्राटीडीज़ पहले फतह से नहीं, सिक्कों से दिखता है—युक्राटीडीज़, जिसे बाद में मेगास, ‘महान’ कहा गया।

panels.shot: close-up on Eucratides’ face lit by lamplight
panels.action: A tight view shows Eucratides’ rugged, thoughtful face half in shadow, features modeled on known coins, as he studies a wax tablet bearing the outline of Bactria and the Indian frontier.

dialogue.text: The record is silent on his youth. Coins show a resolute man, perhaps of noble blood, rising amid palace intrigues in Bactra.

i18n.hi: उसका बचपन इतिहास में गुम है। सिक्कों पर एक अटल चेहरा है, शायद कुलीन खून का, जो बाक्ट्रा के महलों की साज़िशों में ऊपर उठ रहा है।

panels.shot: dramatic interior wide of a dim council chamber
panels.action: In a lamplit council chamber, Eucratides confronts seated Hellenistic rulers whose faces are obscured, while soldiers in Bactrian uniforms watch tensely at the doors.

dialogue.text: Ancient Justin tells of a usurpation. Eucratides seized the Bactrian throne from those who ruled in Demetrius’ name.

i18n.hi: प्राचीन जस्टिन एक हड़प की कहानी सुनाता है। युक्राटीडीज़ ने डेमेट्रियस के नाम पर राज करने वालों से बैक्ट्रियन सिंहासन छीन लिया।

panels.shot: low-angle royal proclamation scene
panels.action: In the palace courtyard, Eucratides stands elevated in full armor, laurel wreath on his head, as heralds raise spears and soldiers kneel, acknowledging his kingship.

dialogue.speaker: eucratides_i
dialogue.text: From this day, Bactria has its own king.

i18n.hi: आज से बैक्ट्रिया का अपना राजा है।

panels.shot: macro shot of a coin being struck
panels.action: A hammer descends on a coin die; in the foreground a fresh silver coin of Eucratides gleams, showing his armored bust and Greek legend, with a seated deity on the reverse.

dialogue.text: His first proclamations were of metal. Silver pieces bore his portrait and titles, spreading his claim along caravan roads.

i18n.hi: उसके पहले एलान धातु के थे। चाँदी के सिक्कों पर उसका चेहरा और खिताब उकेरे गए, जो काफ़िलों के साथ राहों पर उसकी दावेदारी फैला रहे थे।

panels.shot: epic battle wide in a rocky plain below snow peaks
panels.action: Two Hellenistic armies clash in a dusty plain beneath the Hindu Kush; elephants with bell-harnesses loom on one side, while Eucratides rides at the head of a compact Bactrian cavalry wedge.

dialogue.text: Justin speaks of Eucratides at war with Demetrius, ‘king of the Indians’—a civil war of Greeks on both sides of the mountains.

i18n.hi: जस्टिन युक्राटीडीज़ को डेमेट्रियस, ‘भारत के राजा’, के साथ युद्ध में दिखाता है—पहाड़ों के दोनों ओर यूनानियों का गृहयुद्ध।

panels.shot: tense close-up on Eucratides in battle
panels.action: Eucratides, helmet askew and dust-streaked, clenches his jaw as his smaller force faces a vast enemy line stretching across the horizon.

dialogue.text: Our source tells of terrible odds, of Eucratides holding out with a handful against a far larger enemy. The details are lost; the struggle is not.

i18n.hi: हमारा स्रोत भयानक हालात की बात करता है—युक्राटीडीज़ मुट्ठीभर साथियों के साथ कहीं बड़ी फ़ौज के सामने डटा रहा। बारीकियाँ खो गईं, जद्दोजहद नहीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of a defensive night camp under siege
panels.action: Under a starry sky, Eucratides’ camp is ringed with makeshift fortifications; torches burn along the perimeter as weary soldiers reinforce embankments while Eucratides walks the line, cloak wrapped tight.

dialogue.speaker: eucratides_i
dialogue.text: We are Bactria. This earth is our wall.

i18n.hi: हम बैक्ट्रिया हैं। यह धरती ही हमारी दीवार है।

panels.shot: dynamic overhead shot of battle turning
panels.action: Seen from above, a flank of the opposing army breaks as Eucratides’ cavalry strikes at its side; dust clouds swirl as formations unravel toward a riverbank.

dialogue.text: In Justin’s compressed tale, Eucratides survives, his enemies beaten back. The exact fields are unnamed; the outcome is clear—Bactria holds.

i18n.hi: जस्टिन की संक्षिप्त कहानी में युक्राटीडीज़ बच जाता है, दुश्मन पीछे धकेले जाते हैं। मैदानों के नाम अनजाने हैं, नतीजा साफ़ है—बैक्ट्रिया टिकता है।

panels.shot: interior of a mint with monumental feel
panels.action: Inside a grand mint hall, artisans in tunics and caps labor over large dies and crucibles; Eucratides watches as assistants prepare an enormous gold blank.

dialogue.text: With victory came display. In a bold stroke, Eucratides ordered a coin unlike any other of his world.

i18n.hi: फ़तह के साथ दिखावा आया। साहसी चाल में युक्राटीडीज़ ने एक ऐसा सिक्का गढ़वाया जैसा उसके ज़माने ने कभी नहीं देखा था।

panels.shot: close-up on the massive gold stater in a hand
panels.action: A massive gold coin, the famed twenty-stater, rests in Eucratides’ outstretched palm, showing his helmeted head; the coin dwarfs his fingers and gleams in the lamplight.

dialogue.text: This huge gold piece—twenty staters—bore his helmeted likeness and the title Megas. Modern scholars still marvel at its size and ambition.

i18n.hi: यह विशाल सोने का सिक्का—बीस स्टेटर—उसका हेलमेट पहने चेहरा और मेगास का ख़िताब लिए था। आज के विद्वान भी उसके आकार और जुर्रत पर दंग हैं।

panels.shot: montage wide of the coin traveling along trade routes
panels.action: A visual sequence shows the great gold coin passing from a Bactrian treasury to a caravan leader, then to a Greek merchant in a Gandharan market, then to a money-changer in a distant city.

dialogue.text: Carried by caravans, his coins spoke for him in far markets—from Bactra’s walls to Gandharan bazars and beyond.

i18n.hi: काफ़िलों के साथ चलते हुए उसके सिक्के दूर के बाज़ारों में उसकी ज़बान बने—बाक्ट्रा की दीवारों से गांधार के बाज़ारों से भी आगे तक।

panels.shot: map-table overhead shot
panels.action: Over a wooden war table, Eucratides’ hand moves carved tokens across a map showing the Oxus, Bactria, Paropamisadae, and routes into the Kabul valley and Indian plains.

dialogue.text: Yet his triumph had a price. By seizing Bactria, Eucratides split the old Euthydemid realm from the Indo-Greek domains to the east.

i18n.hi: पर यह जीत मुफ़्त नहीं मिली। बैक्ट्रिया पर कब्ज़ा करके युक्राटीडीज़ ने पुराने युथीडेमस राज को पूरब के भारत-यूनानी इलाक़ों से काट दिया।

panels.shot: split-screen style wide of two thrones and two mountain ranges
panels.action: On one side of a central mountain spine, a Greek king sits on a throne marked ‘Bactria’; on the other, beyond snow peaks, another Greek king rules among Indian elephants and stupas.

dialogue.text: The Hindu Kush became not a frontier of empires, but a fault line within a Hellenistic house—a Bactrian kingdom here, Indo-Greek kings there.

i18n.hi: हिंदूकुश अब साम्राज्यों की सीमा नहीं रहा, बल्कि एक ही हेलेनिस्टिक घर के भीतर दरार बन गया—इधर बैक्ट्रियन राज्य, उधर भारत-यूनानी राजा।

panels.shot: somber palace interior, Eucratides older and pensive
panels.action: An older Eucratides, lines etched deeper into his face, sits alone on a simple bench in the palace, crown set aside, gazing at a small chest of coins and sealed scrolls.

dialogue.text: Justin ends with a dark stroke: Eucratides murdered by his own son, his body dragged beneath a chariot and left unburied.

i18n.hi: जस्टिन अंत में काली लकीर खींचता है: युक्राटीडीज़ अपने ही बेटे के हाथों मारा जाता है, उसका शव रथ के नीचे घसीटकर बिना दफ़न छोड़ा जाता है।

panels.shot: shadowy, suggestive scene in a courtyard
panels.action: In a moonlit palace courtyard, a shadowy chariot wheel stands near a fallen figure whose features are obscured; attendants look on in horror, but the scene remains indistinct and symbolic.

dialogue.text: No other source confirms this grim picture. What it preserves is a memory of dynastic hatred, of a house tearing itself apart.

i18n.hi: कोई और स्रोत इस सख़्त तस्वीर की तस्दीक नहीं करता। पर यह राजवंशीय नफ़रत की याद बचाए रखता है—एक घर खुद को बीच से चीरता हुआ।

panels.shot: map wide of Central Asia with waves encroaching
panels.action: A parchment map of Bactria and the Kabul valley lies on a table; ink-dark waves labeled for nomad peoples and new powers spread inward from the north and west, smudging borders.

dialogue.text: As rival Greek kings struggled, new forces gathered—nomad confederations and Parthian rulers, watching a fragmented frontier.

i18n.hi: जब यूनानी राजा आपस में भिड़ रहे थे, नए बल उभर रहे थे—घुमंतू संघ और पार्थियन शासक, जो इस बिखरी हुई सीमा को टकटकी लगाए देख रहे थे।

panels.shot: quiet museum-like close-up of Eucratides coins under glass
panels.action: Under soft light, a display case shows a range of Eucratides’ coins, including the great gold stater and smaller bronzes, alongside a label-less shard of Gandharan sculpture in the background.

dialogue.text: Today, Eucratides Megas lives in metal: portraits, titles, and a giant gold coin, witness to a king whose civil war remade the map from Bactria to India.

i18n.hi: आज युक्राटीडीज़ मेगास धातु में ज़िंदा है: चेहरे, खिताब, और वह दैत्याकार सोने का सिक्का—एक ऐसे राजा की गवाही, जिसका गृहयुद्ध बैक्ट्रिया से भारत तक का नक्शा बदल गया।

title_i18n.en: Eucratides and the Civil War of Kings

subtitle_i18n.en: Megas in the Mountains: How Eucratides Split the Greek East
subtitle_i18n.hi: पहाड़ों का मेगास: कैसे युक्राटीडीज़ ने यूनानी पूरब बाँट दिया
